title: P5: make node OCOMP signing follow each finalized job snapshot
description:
## Mandatory test-first execution

Implement this task as vertical RED → GREEN cycles. Before each production change, add one focused behavioral test through a public/production interface, run it, and record the exact command plus the expected failure in the issue notes. Add only enough production code to make that test and its nearest regression pass, then continue with the next behavior. The Tests section below is a behavior backlog, not a post-implementation phase. Never refactor while RED.

## Goal

Remove static committee/index configuration from validator nodes and make the attestation/sign-once/vote-submission pipeline resolve the local member from each finalized intent historical ValidatorSet snapshot.

## Files owned by this task

- crates/blockchain/node/src/ocomp/attestation.rs
- crates/blockchain/node/src/ocomp/sign_once.rs
- crates/blockchain/node/src/ocomp/retention.rs
- crates/blockchain/node/src/ocomp/finality.rs
- crates/blockchain/node/src/ocomp/control.rs and snapshot_control.rs where job-scoped authority is exported
- crates/blockchain/node/src/ocomp/signer.rs only for local key matching
- crates/blockchain/node/src/ocomp/tests/*
- crates/blockchain/engine/src/args.rs and stack.rs
- bin/outbe-ocomp/src/vote_submitter.rs and its tests
- node RPC/status types exposing old u8 bitmaps or static committee hash

## Required changes

1. Remove configured validator_index and OcompCommitteeSnapshotV1 from OcompNodeAttestationConfig, CLI args and engine stack. The chain manifest no longer supplies a static result committee.
2. Validator mode is fail-closed at startup when OCOMP voting configuration or key is absent on an OCOMP-enabled chain. FullNode mode starts without an OCOMP signing/relay key and never votes.
3. FinalizedAttestationAuthority::reload_exported must use the retention registry record_for_job path rather than coordinator status so every simultaneously live/exported job can be served. Do not silently select only the latest job.
4. From the finalized JobIntentV1, load the exact historical ValidatorSet OCOMP snapshot identified by result_validator_set_epoch, result_committee_set_hash and result_ocomp_binding_hash. Resolve the local validator address and u16 participant index in its ordered members and require its stored OCOMP public key/key_epoch to match the local signer.
5. Node-side missing or evicted pinned snapshot means abstain. Emit a counter/metric and an error log containing job id and all three bindings. Never substitute the current snapshot and never create an unsigned or partially bound vote.
6. SignOnceSubjectV1 and durable SignOnceRecordV1 use all three bindings plus u16 participant index. Exact retry after restart or after a membership boundary returns the byte-identical signature; a changed binding or digest is equivocation.
7. Build ResultVoteV1 with the exact finalized intent bindings and dynamic index. Final verification before return reloads authority and canonical height as today.
8. Update SupervisorVoteSubmitterV1 and journal validation for the new vote wire form and dynamic calldata/gas cap. Submission durability semantics stay unchanged.
9. Finalization proof decoding must bound historical committee data from the pinned snapshot and current consensus bound, not POC_COMMITTEE_SIZE.

## Documentation owned by this task

- Update docs/becoming-a-validator.md with the validator OCOMP configuration, registration artifact, confirm-ready command semantics, FullNode-to-validator transition and restart/abstain behavior.

## Tests

- static validator-index/committee CLI configuration is gone; validator startup without OCOMP config fails; FullNode startup without it succeeds and exposes no vote capability.
- two live jobs from different membership epochs can both reload/export/sign.
- local validator present in old and new snapshots signs with the correct per-job u16 index; a validator absent from a job abstains.
- missing snapshot, hash mismatch and local key mismatch abstain with metric/log and never fallback.
- sign-once exact retry across restart and boundary returns ExactRetry; changed one of three bindings yields Equivocation.
- vote submitter prepares, persists, rebroadcasts and finalizes the new canonical vote unchanged.

## Out of scope

Full nodes do not independently recompute Lysis in this task; that is the separate deferred follower issue. No OCOMP key rotation.
design: Reuse the existing finalized intent/retention authority and provider-backed historical snapshot readers. Keep the irreversible sign-once boundary after the second authority reload and immediately before signing.
acceptance_criteria: Validator nodes derive membership and key from each job pinned historical snapshot, all live jobs remain signable, static index/committee configuration is removed, missing state abstains observably, FullNode needs no voting key, and node plus vote-submitter tests pass. For every implemented behavior, the issue contains RED command/failure evidence followed by focused GREEN evidence; production code was not written before its behavioral test. Every documentation path assigned to this task describes the same GREEN production behavior; the task cannot close with stale fixed OCOMP membership, quorum or slot assertions.
notes: Plan mapping: section 8 node runtime, per-job snapshot resolution, sign-once/restart behavior and FullNode/validator startup split.
close_reason: Per-job historical snapshot signing, abstention observability, dynamic u16 vote submission and restart semantics verified; P6 removed the final harness blocker.

title: P4: verify dynamic historical OCOMP votes and zero-fee authorization
description:
## Mandatory test-first execution

Implement this task as vertical RED → GREEN cycles. Before each production change, add one focused behavioral test through a public/production interface, run it, and record the exact command plus the expected failure in the issue notes. Add only enough production code to make that test and its nearest regression pass, then continue with the next behavior. The Tests section below is a behavior backlog, not a post-implementation phase. Never refactor while RED.

## Goal

Use each job attempt pinned ValidatorSet snapshot for vote signature verification, fee authorization, quorum and accountability without consulting current ACTIVE membership.

## Files owned by this task

- crates/core/metadosis/src/ocomp/vote.rs
- narrow follow-up edits in crates/core/metadosis/src/ocomp/activation.rs and transitions.rs for dynamic quorum/bitmap propagation
- crates/core/metadosis/src/precompile.rs and ABI ingress tests
- crates/system/zerofee/src/hooks.rs
- crates/system/zerofee/src/ocomp.rs; crates/system/zerofee/src/oracle.rs only to prove its semantics are unchanged
- crates/blockchain/evm/src/precompiles.rs, executor/txpool preflight wiring and OCOMP vote lifecycle tests
- RPC/view structs that expose signer bitmaps or the old single committee hash

## Vote path

Process a public vote in this exact order: bounded ABI prefix decode; locate job; compare all three vote bindings to the intent; load the pinned ValidatorSet snapshot by epoch plus consensus and OCOMP hashes; compare stored epoch and both hashes; check u16 participant index and O(1) member; verify key_epoch and the inner OCOMP signature; record the verified vote.

A missing or evicted pinned snapshot, a ring collision, mismatched binding, absent member or bad signature must return the canonical vote_reject revert. Caller-controlled ingress must never produce Fatal. There is no fallback to the current snapshot.

The job header owns N and quorum. Quorum formation and close use the dynamic monolithic accountability object and dynamic LSB0 bitmaps. Completed/terminal receipts, RPC views and evidence carry full byte-vector bitmaps and all three bindings.

## Zero-fee path

1. Reuse the single protocol prefix decoder in txpool classification, preflight and execution. No duplicated ABI offsets or partial layout parser.
2. Extend the OCOMP ZeroFee candidate context so stateful authorization receives the job id and all three pinned bindings extracted by classification. The current ZeroFeeCandidate shape containing only hook and signer is insufficient.
3. Add an OCOMP-specific resolver that resolves the direct validator or its current explicit OCOMP delegate without requiring current ACTIVE status, then requires that validator address at the pinned historical participant index. Preserve the existing rule that an explicit delegate disables direct validator signing for that role.
4. Do not change Oracle-role resolution semantics.
5. Pool and execution must produce the same waiver decision for the same transaction and state. Truncated calldata must never panic.
6. OCOMP votes remain ordinary EVM transactions. No OCOMP gossip topic or P2P membership change is introduced.

## Documentation owned by this task

- Update docs/adr/system/ADR-S-FEE-001-zero-fee-policy.md for historical pinned-snapshot OCOMP fee authorization without changing Oracle semantics.
- Update docs/flows/002-off-chain-poc-protocol-flow.md and docs/flows/011-validator-operational-key-delegation.md so membership, quorum, delegate resolution and accountability match the implemented dynamic path.

## Tests

- a participant from an old 4-member job can vote after a 4 to 5 boundary even if it is no longer current ACTIVE; a validator only in the new snapshot cannot vote on the old job.
- missing historical snapshot rejects and leaves job to expire without halting the block.
- wrong epoch, consensus hash, OCOMP hash, u16 index, key epoch or signature rejects.
- N=4 forms quorum at 3; N=5 at 4; dynamic bitmap/accountability output is stable.
- direct signer/delegate behavior is identical in txpool and execution; current ACTIVE is not consulted for a historical job; Oracle tests remain unchanged.
- canonical prefix parser handles exact envelope, truncated offset/length, bad padding, overflow and oversized payload.

## Out of scope

No node signing changes and no full-node Lysis follower in this issue.
design: The inner OCOMP signature is the consensus authorization for the vote transition. The transaction signer only controls fee sponsorship and is resolved against the historical snapshot after role delegation resolution.
acceptance_criteria: Every accepted vote is verified against the exact pinned historical ValidatorSet OCOMP key; missing snapshots revert rather than halt; dynamic quorum and byte-vector accountability are persisted; txpool and executor share one decoder and identical zero-fee resolution; focused Metadosis, ZeroFee and EVM tests pass. For every implemented behavior, the issue contains RED command/failure evidence followed by focused GREEN evidence; production code was not written before its behavioral test. Every documentation path assigned to this task describes the same GREEN production behavior; the task cannot close with stale fixed OCOMP membership, quorum or slot assertions.
notes: Plan mapping: sections 5-7 for historical vote verification, dynamic quorum/accountability propagation, canonical decoder and ZeroFee authorization.
close_reason: Historical pinned-snapshot vote verification, canonical ZeroFee authorization, dynamic accountability regressions, txpool/executor parity evidence and assigned documentation are GREEN.

title: P3: pin each OCOMP attempt to a historical ValidatorSet snapshot
description:
## Mandatory test-first execution

Implement this task as vertical RED → GREEN cycles. Before each production change, add one focused behavioral test through a public/production interface, run it, and record the exact command plus the expected failure in the issue notes. Add only enough production code to make that test and its nearest regression pass, then continue with the next behavior. The Tests section below is a behavior backlog, not a post-implementation phase. Never refactor while RED.

## Goal

Remove the fork-installed static result committee and make Metadosis derive immutable membership bindings, N and quorum from ValidatorSet state when each attempt is committed.

## Files owned by this task

- crates/core/metadosis/Cargo.toml
- crates/core/metadosis/src/ocomp/profile.rs
- crates/core/metadosis/src/ocomp/fork.rs
- crates/core/metadosis/src/ocomp/authority.rs
- crates/core/metadosis/src/ocomp/request.rs
- crates/core/metadosis/src/ocomp/transitions.rs
- crates/core/metadosis/src/ocomp/expiry.rs
- crates/core/metadosis/src/ocomp/activation.rs only for removal of static authority and completed binding shape
- crates/core/metadosis/src/schema.rs and proof_layout.rs
- crates/core/metadosis/src/api.rs, commit.rs, fixture.rs and ocomp/test_support.rs where install/profile/intent shapes are assembled
- crates/core/metadosis/src/tests and crates/blockchain/evm/tests/ocomp_request_lifecycle.rs
- crates/blockchain/evm/src/precompiles.rs and engine fork-install plumbing only where static install fields are decoded or authorized

## Required changes

1. Remove result_committee_snapshot_hash from OcompRequestProfile and remove result_committee from OcompForkInstallV1 and OcompActivationAuthorityV1. Fork install continues to bind the chain, protocol bundle, correctness/capacity/source profiles and activation height.
2. Keep the existing Metadosis schema field at order 17 as a reserved zero-valued field of exactly the same storage type and width. Do not delete or shift it. Tests must prove METADOSIS_STORAGE_LAYOUT_V1_HASH is unchanged and the reserved field remains zero.
3. At fresh request and retry construction, read the current strict ValidatorSet historical snapshot extension by current epoch/key. Populate JobIntentV1 with result_validator_set_epoch, result_committee_set_hash and result_ocomp_binding_hash.
4. commit_ocomp_request is the normative derivation point: read the pinned snapshot, require N >= 1, derive N from member_count and quorum from the shared simplex_n3f1_quorum(N), and persist both in the job/accountability header. Neither request input nor caller may choose N or quorum.
5. Attempt/intent owns the snapshot pin. WorldwideDay owns the retry chain. A retry uses the then-current snapshot; remove the current check that a retry must equal the static profile committee hash.
6. Any stored epoch/hash mismatch or evicted snapshot is missing. Request commit without a valid pinned snapshot is internal fatal because it is system-generated; public vote handling is addressed separately and must revert.
7. Add an AwaitingFinality deadline independent of late-finalization credits: intent_height + 64. When it expires, release live-job capacity and schedule the existing bounded retry/terminal transition. Do not use LATE_FINALIZE_WINDOW_K.
8. Keep response voting open at finality_recorded_height + RESULT_VOTE_MIN_FINALITY_DEPTH and close at open_height + result_deadline_blocks.
9. Initialize dynamic OcompVoteAccountabilityV1 with all three bindings, N and quorum when voting opens.
10. Remove every static committee comparison from activation and install identity. Protocol-bundle identity remains authoritative.

## Documentation owned by this task

- Rewrite the fixed committee/q=3/four-slot and install-authority portions of docs/adr/system/ADR-S-OCM-004-certified-activation-job-fsm-and-protocol-versioning.md to dynamic pinned N/quorum/accountability and remove result committee membership from fork authority.

## Tests

- caller cannot alter N or quorum; exact values for N=1, 4, 5, 6, 7 and current consensus-bound synthetic snapshot use the common helper.
- fresh attempt pins current snapshot; retry after a boundary pins the new snapshot while the prior terminal record remains unchanged.
- missing/mismatched current snapshot blocks request creation deterministically.
- AwaitingFinality expires at its own deadline and releases MAX_LIVE_JOBS capacity; finality before deadline follows the existing open/close window.
- static install artifact no longer includes committee bytes and exact replay remains canonical.
- order-17 reserved storage remains zero and METADOSIS_STORAGE_LAYOUT_V1_HASH is unchanged.

## Out of scope

No public vote signature verification or zero-fee change here. No full-node follower. No compatibility decoder for the old install artifact because the network restarts from genesis.
design: Metadosis depends on ValidatorSet read helpers rather than copying storage offsets. Missing state during internal request construction is Fatal; external vote ingress will map missing historical snapshots to a canonical vote rejection in the next task.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh and retry attempts pin the exact historical ValidatorSet snapshot and persist consensus-derived N/quorum; static committee is absent from fork/profile/authority; AwaitingFinality cannot retain capacity forever; Metadosis layout hash is unchanged; focused Metadosis and EVM request tests pass. For every implemented behavior, the issue contains RED command/failure evidence followed by focused GREEN evidence; production code was not written before its behavioral test. title: P2: enforce OCOMP registration in ValidatorSet admission and boundary snapshots
description:
## Mandatory test-first execution

Implement this task as vertical RED → GREEN cycles. Before each production change, add one focused behavioral test through a public/production interface, run it, and record the exact command plus the expected failure in the issue notes. Add only enough production code to make that test and its nearest regression pass, then continue with the next behavior. The Tests section below is a behavior backlog, not a post-implementation phase. Never refactor while RED.

## Goal

Make OCOMP readiness a consensus membership prerequisite and persist historical OCOMP keys beside, but never inside, the existing consensus committee snapshot.

## Files owned by this task

- crates/blockchain/consensus/src/bls.rs, proof/verifier.rs and public re-exports needed for the shared validator bound and simplex_n3f1_quorum
- crates/system/validatorset/Cargo.toml
- crates/system/validatorset/src/schema.rs
- crates/system/validatorset/src/runtime.rs
- crates/system/validatorset/src/state.rs
- crates/system/validatorset/src/hooks.rs
- crates/system/validatorset/src/precompile.rs and lib.rs
- contracts/precompiles/src/IValidatorSet.sol
- bin/outbe-cli/src/abi.rs and validator command encoding affected by the ABI
- ValidatorSet unit/integration tests, especially crates/system/validatorset/tests/snapshot_store.rs
- one shared test-only activation helper replacing direct activation calls throughout workspace tests

## Registration and lifecycle

1. Add canonical OCOMP registration storage per validator plus a reverse reservation from OCOMP public-key hash to validator. Add only append-only ValidatorSet fields at storage ordinals 50 or later.
2. confirmValidatorReady(registration) must be the only readiness transition. In one storage checkpoint it requires caller status PENDING, validates canonical registration chain id and genesis hash, recomputes validator identity from caller plus the current 48-byte BLS MinPk key using the single protocol helper, verifies PoP, key_epoch=1 and purpose, enforces unique OCOMP key ownership, writes registration/reverse reservation and only then sets val_join_confirmed and pending_set_change.
3. Exact byte-identical registration replay is allowed. A different valid registration atomically replaces the old one and releases the old reverse reservation.
4. mark_pending, exit, jail/unjail paths and full validator cleanup reset readiness as appropriate. Re-entry from EXITED/INACTIVE requires a new confirmValidatorReady. If re-registration changes the BLS key, clear the old OCOMP registration and reverse reservation at the same point the old BLS reverse mapping is cleared.
5. get_reshare_target_set admits PENDING only when both readiness and a valid stored OCOMP registration are present. REGISTERED must never be promoted.
6. activate_reshared_set_with_expiry_exclusions accepts a newly active member only from confirmed PENDING with a valid registration; ACTIVE incumbents remain valid. Missing registration in a certified new_active_set is an internal fatal invariant, not exclusion after certification.
7. Remove the production activate_validator path and owner activateResharedSet ABI/dispatch/CLI surface. Replace direct test activations with one shared test helper that drives the production boundary activation hook.
8. At every config_max_validators write/initialization path, assert it does not exceed the exported consensus bound. OCOMP does not add another bound.

## Historical snapshot extension

1. Do not modify CommitteeEntry, CommitteeSnapshot or committee_set_hash_v2.
2. Add a separate extension keyed by the existing committee_snapshot_key. Store its own epoch, consensus committee hash, ocomp_binding_hash, member count, per-index compressed SEC1 OCOMP key and key_epoch.
3. ocomp_binding_hash commits to epoch, consensus hash, ordered validator addresses, OCOMP keys and key epochs. It is stored per committee_snapshot_key.
4. Boundary write order is consensus fields, OCOMP extension, metadata, exists flag last. An exact replay must match all fields byte-for-byte.
5. clear_committee_snapshot first reads exists and returns when false; when true it reads all lengths before clearing exists, then clears consensus and extension fields. Eviction and replacement happen inside the same boundary checkpoint.
6. Add O(1) read of a member by index and a strict read by epoch plus both hashes. Ring collisions or mismatched stored epoch/hash values return missing, never a newer colliding snapshot.
7. activate_boundary_atomic writes outgoing and incoming OCOMP extensions in the same checkpoint as activation. It reads admitted registration state; it does not reverify PoP at boundary.
8. Startup validation for an OCOMP-enabled chain reads COMMITTEE_SNAPSHOT_RETAIN_EPOCHS and enforces ((retain - 1) * epoch_length_blocks) > (64 + RESULT_VOTE_MIN_FINALITY_DEPTH + result_deadline_blocks). Small isolated ValidatorSet tests that do not enable OCOMP are not subject to this manifest check.

## Documentation owned by this task

- Update docs/adr/system/ADR-S-VAL-001-validator-registry-and-committee-eligibility.md and ADR-S-VAL-002-role-scoped-validator-operational-keys.md for OCOMP admission, registration cleanup/re-entry, snapshot extension and delegate-versus-membership separation.
- Update docs/flows/006-validator-join-operation-and-exit.md for the real confirmValidatorReady(registration) and certified boundary flow.

## Tests

Cover first admission, exact replay, conflicting key, replacement and reservation release, BLS key change, full cleanup, re-entry confirmation, REGISTERED bypass rejection, unconfirmed PENDING exclusion, certified activation gate, snapshot exact replay, rollback, ring collision, clear ordering, O(1) indexed read, unchanged committee_set_hash_v2 vectors and no mutation of reserved slot 40.

## Out of scope

Do not add key rotation, expiry or recovery. Do not put OCOMP bytes into CommitteeEntry. Do not change peer membership or DCAP.
design: ValidatorSet owns current admission and historical snapshot storage because it is already the source of ACTIVE membership and owns the atomic certified boundary hook. SEC1 keys are stored in fixed-width split fields so member-at-index reads remain O(1). Registration canonical bytes may be stored as bounded StorageBytes with a separate reverse key reservation.
acceptance_criteria: A validator cannot enter a new ACTIVE set without a stored valid OCOMP registration; every certified ACTIVE member has a historical OCOMP extension entry; consensus committee hashes remain byte-identical; re-entry and BLS-key replacement clean reservations; public manual activation surfaces are gone; ValidatorSet tests pass. For every implemented behavior, the issue contains RED command/failure evidence followed by focused GREEN evidence; production code was not written before its behavioral test. Every documentation path assigned to this task describes the same GREEN production behavior; the task cannot close with stale fixed OCOMP membership, quorum or slot assertions.
notes:
Plan mapping: section 2 admission/activation and section 3 ValidatorSet historical OCOMP extension, retention and lifecycle invariants.
RED 1 — confirmValidatorReady atomically persists a canonical OCOMP registration and reverse key reservation before readiness. Command: cargo test -q -p outbe-validatorset tests::confirm_ready_persists_valid_ocomp_registration_before_readiness -- --exact. Exit 101. Expected compile failures: confirm_validator_ready accepts no registration bytes, ValidatorSet has no ocomp_registration read interface, and no ocomp_key_hash_to_validator storage field.
GREEN 1 — confirmValidatorReady accepts canonical registration bytes, verifies canonical codec/PoP plus immutable chain/genesis/current address+BLS identity, reserves the OCOMP key, stores registration bytes and only then sets readiness inside one checkpoint. Command: cargo test -q -p outbe-validatorset tests::confirm_ready_persists_valid_ocomp_registration_before_readiness -- --exact. Exit 0: 1 passed, 0 failed. ABI is now confirmValidatorReady(bytes registration); P2 docs updated in the same slice.
RED 2 — byte-identical OCOMP registration replay succeeds and a different valid registration atomically replaces the key while releasing the old reverse reservation. Command: cargo test -q -p outbe-validatorset tests::confirm_ready_exact_replay_and_atomic_ocomp_key_replacement -- --exact. Exit 101. Expected assertion failure: current safe interim branch returns Revert("different OCOMP registration requires atomic replacement").
GREEN 2 — exact replay and atomic registration replacement. Command: cargo test -q -p outbe-validatorset tests::confirm_ready_exact_replay_and_atomic_ocomp_key_replacement -- --exact (plus GREEN 1 nearest regression). Exit 0: both focused tests passed. Replacement conflict-checks the new key before the checkpoint, clears a changed old key reservation inside the checkpoint, then writes canonical bytes/new reservation/readiness.
RED 3 — DKG target fails closed when readiness is true but no canonical OCOMP registration exists. Command: cargo test -q -p outbe-validatorset tests::reshare_target_requires_registration_even_if_readiness_flag_is_set -- --exact. Exit 101. Expected assertion failure: get_reshare_target_set currently checks only val_join_confirmed and includes the keyless PENDING validator.
GREEN 3 — get_reshare_target_set requires both val_join_confirmed and a decodable stored OCOMP registration for PENDING members. Command: cargo test -q -p outbe-validatorset tests::reshare_target_requires_registration_even_if_readiness_flag_is_set -- --exact plus existing admitted/reshare behavior regression. Exit 0: both passed.
RED 4 — changing the BLS key on INACTIVE re-registration clears the old OCOMP registration, its reverse reservation and readiness. Command: cargo test -q -p outbe-validatorset tests::bls_key_change_clears_ocomp_registration_and_reservation -- --exact. Exit 101. Expected assertion failure: stale OcompKeyRegistrationV1 remains stored after the consensus BLS identity changes.
GREEN 4 — BLS identity replacement clears OCOMP registration/reservation and readiness at the re-registration write point; same-BLS re-entry still resets readiness and may later exact-replay its registration. Command: cargo test -q -p outbe-validatorset tests::bls_key_change_clears_ocomp_registration_and_reservation -- --exact plus no-cooldown re-registration regression. Exit 0.
RED 5 — full INACTIVE validator cleanup releases OCOMP registration bytes and reverse key ownership. Command: cargo test -q -p outbe-validatorset tests::full_validator_cleanup_releases_ocomp_registration_and_key -- --exact. Exit 101. Expected assertion failure: swap-removal clears legacy fields but leaves the canonical OCOMP registration reachable.
GREEN 5 — clear_validator_storage invokes the same registration cleanup seam before swap-removal, releasing both canonical bytes and reverse key reservation. Command: cargo test -q -p outbe-validatorset tests::full_validator_cleanup_releases_ocomp_registration_and_key -- --exact plus both existing cleanup regressions. Exit 0: all three passed.
RED 6 — certified activation refuses REGISTERED and keyless/unconfirmed PENDING members as Fatal admission invariant violations. Command: cargo test -q -p outbe-validatorset tests::certified_activation_rejects_registered_and_keyless_pending_members -- --exact. Exit 101. Expected failure: activate_reshared_set returns Ok and directly promotes REGISTERED.
GREEN 6 — activate_reshared_set prevalidates the entire certified incoming set before clearing shares: ACTIVE incumbents are accepted; only confirmed PENDING with stored registration may be promoted; REGISTERED, keyless/unconfirmed PENDING, unregistered and ineligible statuses are Fatal. Command: focused rejection test plus test_stale_join_guard_resets_on_restake positive confirmed-PENDING regression. Exit 0.
RED 7 — writing a consensus CommitteeSnapshot also persists a separate strict OCOMP extension without changing committee_set_hash_v2; O(1) member lookup and strict epoch+two-hash lookup are public reads. Command: cargo test -q -p outbe-validatorset --test snapshot_store committee_snapshot_persists_separate_strict_ocomp_extension -- --exact. Exit 101. Expected compile failure: read_ocomp_snapshot_extension, read_ocomp_snapshot_extension_for_binding and read_ocomp_snapshot_member_at do not exist.
GREEN 7 — write_committee_snapshot resolves every admitted OCOMP registration before mutation, stores epoch/consensus hash/OCOMP binding hash/member count and per-index SEC1 key+key_epoch in append-only slots 52..58, without changing CommitteeSnapshot or committee_set_hash_v2. Public O(1) member lookup and strict epoch+consensus-hash+OCOMP-hash lookup return missing on mismatch. Command: cargo test -q -p outbe-validatorset --test snapshot_store committee_snapshot_persists_separate_strict_ocomp_extension -- --exact. Exit 0: 1 passed, 0 failed.
GREEN 7 nearest regression — updated pre-existing snapshot_store fixtures to satisfy the new production invariant by admitting OCOMP registrations through the public confirm-ready path; no product gate was weakened. Command: cargo test -q -p outbe-validatorset --test snapshot_store. Exit 0: 13 passed, 0 failed.
RED 8 — exact committee snapshot replay is accepted only when both consensus and OCOMP extension bytes match; OCOMP registration drift for the same snapshot key must fail before mutation. Command: cargo test -q -p outbe-validatorset --test snapshot_store committee_snapshot_exact_replay_rejects_ocomp_binding_drift -- --exact. Exit 101. Expected assertion failure: current writer returns Ok and overwrites the extension after replacing the admitted OCOMP key.
GREEN 8 — existing snapshot keys are handled as a read-only exact replay: the writer compares the full consensus snapshot, extension metadata and every indexed OCOMP member before returning the existing identity. Any drift is Fatal before mutation. Command: focused exact-replay test followed by cargo test -q -p outbe-validatorset --test snapshot_store. Exit 0: focused 1/1 and suite 14/14 passed.
RED 9 — clear_committee_snapshot must reclaim all consensus and OCOMP extension fields while keeping reserved slot 40 zero. Command: cargo test -q -p outbe-validatorset --test snapshot_store clear_committee_snapshot_zeroes_consensus_and_ocomp_extension -- --exact. Exit 101. Expected assertion failure: extension epoch remains 11 because the legacy clear path only zeroes consensus slots.
GREEN 9 — clear_committee_snapshot reads consensus/VRF/OCOMP loop bounds before clearing exists, then reclaims all consensus and extension metadata/member slots; reserved slot 40 is untouched. Command: focused clear test followed by full snapshot_store suite. Exit 0: focused 1/1 and suite 15/15 passed.
GREEN 6/7 package regression — migrated nine legacy ValidatorSet fixtures from REGISTERED→certified-active bypass to mark_pending + canonical confirm-ready admission before reshare, without weakening production validation. Command: cargo test -q -p outbe-validatorset. Exit 0: lib 75/75, snapshot_store 15/15, doc/aux 2/2.
RED 10 — direct runtime activation must not bypass the certified boundary. Command: cargo test -q -p outbe-validatorset tests::manual_validator_activation_cannot_bypass_certified_boundary -- --exact. Exit 101. Expected assertion failure: activate_validator currently returns Ok and mutates REGISTERED directly to ACTIVE.
GREEN 10a — direct activate_validator is fail-closed during caller migration and cannot change lifecycle state; only the certified reshare path can promote PENDING. Command: cargo test -q -p outbe-validatorset tests::manual_validator_activation_cannot_bypass_certified_boundary -- --exact. Exit 0: 1 passed. Next in the same slice: migrate tests to one boundary helper, then delete the temporary method and owner ABI.
RED 11 — one shared test helper must admit a registered validator and drive the real activate_boundary_atomic hook, leaving both ACTIVE/share state and the historical OCOMP snapshot. Command: cargo test -q -p outbe-validatorset --test snapshot_store shared_test_activation_helper_drives_production_boundary_hook -- --exact. Exit 101. Expected compile failure: outbe_validatorset::test_support::activate_validator_via_boundary does not exist.
GREEN 11 — added the single shared activate_validator_via_boundary test helper. It derives a deterministic purpose-bound OCOMP registration when needed, runs mark_pending + confirm-ready, preserves current ACTIVE members, orders by BLS key, and invokes activate_boundary_atomic; it never writes ACTIVE/share directly. Command: focused helper test. Exit 0: 1 passed and historical snapshot/extension were persisted.
RED 12 — the owner/manual activateResharedSet(address[],bytes32) selector must not exist in the ValidatorSet ABI. Command: cargo test -q -p outbe-validatorset tests::owner_manual_reshare_selector_is_not_exposed -- --exact. Exit 101. Expected assertion failure: selector is still present in generated IValidatorSetCalls::SELECTORS.
GREEN 10b/12 — all legacy direct activation fixtures now use the shared certified-boundary helper; runtime activate_validator was deleted. The owner activateResharedSet selector was removed from Solidity, precompile dispatch, CLI ABI and exported JSON. Command: focused selector test. Exit 0: selector absent. Migration gates already GREEN: validatorset, slashindicator, staking/governance/update/vote, EVM lib 189/189 and e2e.
RED 13 — validator confirm-ready CLI must read a canonical binary registration file and send its exact bytes in confirmValidatorReady(bytes). Command: cargo test -q -p outbe-cli test_confirm_ready_sends_exact_registration_file_bytes -- --exact. Exit 101. Expected compile failures: CLI ABI has no registration field and confirm_ready accepts no path.
GREEN 13 — CLI ABI now matches confirmValidatorReady(bytes); validator confirm-ready requires --registration PATH, reads non-empty binary bytes and sends them byte-for-byte. Command: cargo test -q -p outbe-cli test_confirm_ready_sends_exact_registration_file_bytes. Exit 0: 1 passed, 0 failed.
RED 14 — config_max_validators must be written only through a setter bounded by the current consensus MAX_VALIDATORS; MAX is accepted and MAX+1 rejected without mutation. Command: cargo test -q -p outbe-validatorset tests::config_max_validators_cannot_exceed_consensus_bound -- --exact. Exit 101. Expected compile failure: set_config_max_validators does not exist.
GREEN 14 — added set_config_max_validators, bounded only by outbe_consensus::bls::MAX_VALIDATORS; MAX+1 reverts before mutation. All Rust config write sites now use the setter, so OCOMP introduces no independent literal/cap. Command: focused bound test plus cargo test -q -p outbe-validatorset. Exit 0: focused 1/1; package 77/77 + 16/16 + 2/2.
RED 15 — OCOMP-enabled startup must enforce strict snapshot-retention horizon: epochLengthBlocks=18 rejects and 19 accepts for ((8-1)*epoch) > (64+4+64). Command: cargo test -q -p outbe-node startup_rejects_ocomp_snapshot_retention_horizon_that_is_too_short. Exit 101. Expected assertion failure: startup currently accepts epochLengthBlocks=18.
GREEN 15 — startup validation for an OCOMP-enabled chain reads COMMITTEE_SNAPSHOT_RETAIN_EPOCHS, epochLengthBlocks and the installed result_deadline_blocks, then enforces strict ((retain-1)*epoch) > (64+RESULT_VOTE_MIN_FINALITY_DEPTH+deadline) with checked arithmetic. Command: cargo test -q -p outbe-node startup_rejects_ocomp_snapshot_retention_horizon_that_is_too_short. Exit 0: epochLengthBlocks=18 rejected and 19 accepted.
P2 acceptance coverage — added a focused same-BLS INACTIVE re-entry regression: canonical registration remains available for exact replay, readiness is reset, the PENDING validator is excluded from DKG until it calls confirmValidatorReady again, then becomes eligible. Documentation GREEN — rewrote the existing ADR-S-VAL-001, ADR-S-VAL-002 and PFS-006 sections to the implemented registration/readiness, cleanup/re-entry, separate snapshot extension, certified-only activation and delegate-vs-membership behavior; updated README and the validator operator guide for removal of activateResharedSet and the required outbe-keygen ocomp + confirm-ready --registration flow. No new ADR and no fixed OCOMP membership text was introduced.

title: P1: make OCOMP protocol wire forms membership-dynamic
description:
## Mandatory test-first execution

Implement this task as vertical RED → GREEN cycles. Before each production change, add one focused behavioral test through a public/production interface, run it, and record the exact command plus the expected failure in the issue notes. Add only enough production code to make that test and its nearest regression pass, then continue with the next behavior. The Tests section below is a behavior backlog, not a post-implementation phase. Never refactor while RED.

## Goal

Remove every fixed four-member assumption from canonical OCOMP protocol types before stateful consumers are changed.

## Files owned by this task

- crates/system/ocomp-protocol/src/committee.rs
- crates/system/ocomp-protocol/src/intent.rs
- crates/system/ocomp-protocol/src/vote.rs
- crates/system/ocomp-protocol/src/activation.rs
- crates/system/ocomp-protocol/src/state.rs
- crates/system/ocomp-protocol/src/capacity.rs and generated shape inputs directly affected by wire size
- crates/system/ocomp-protocol/src/schema.rs only where bounded dynamic decoding needs it
- crates/system/ocomp-protocol/registry/ocomp-v1.tsv, schema-v1.tsv, preimages-v1.tsv and generated registry outputs
- crates/system/ocomp-protocol/tests/typed_protocol.rs, finality_vectors.rs and registry/golden-vector tests

## Required changes

1. Simplify OcompKeyRegistrationCoreV1: remove committee-relative validator_index, fork_id, protocol-bundle binding and height validity. Keep chain_id, genesis_hash, validator identity, compressed SEC1 OCOMP public key, fixed key_epoch=1 and result-signature purpose. PoP remains chain/genesis/identity/key-bound and low-S verified.
2. Replace the single result_committee_snapshot_hash in JobIntentV1, ResultVoteV1, ResultVoteSigningSubjectV1, SignOnceRecordV1 and all related exact-replay/signing preimages with the three explicit bindings result_validator_set_epoch, result_committee_set_hash and result_ocomp_binding_hash.
3. Change participant indices in new wire forms and vote slots from u8 to u16.
4. Make OcompVoteAccountabilityV1 dynamic: store N and quorum threshold, create exactly N Vec<Option<ResultVoteSlotV1>> slots, and keep the existing bounded O(N) quorum scan.
5. Replace u8 quorum/accountability bitmaps, including OcompQuorumV1 and OcompCompletedBindingV1, with bounded byte vectors of ceil(N/8). Normative order is LSB0: participant i uses byte floor(i/8), bit i mod 8; index 0 is the low bit of byte 0; unused high bits in the last byte must be zero.
6. Accountability remains monolithic and self-contained: job id, the three bindings, N, quorum threshold, slots, formed OcompQuorumV1 and closed summary. Do not add per-slot storage maps, tally caches, pruning or evidence caches.
7. Add one canonical bounded submitLysisResult ABI prefix decoder beside ResultVoteV1. The full canonical decoder must invoke it first. Stateful txpool/execution consumers will reuse this exact function in a later task.
8. Remove POC_COMMITTEE_SIZE and POC_COMMITTEE_THRESHOLD from semantic logic. POC_KEY_EPOCH may remain fixed at 1.

## Documentation owned by this task

- Rewrite docs/adr/system/ADR-S-OCM-003-deterministic-execution-and-quorum-evidence.md in place before the first production change. Do not create a new ADR and do not preserve fixed 4/q=3/four-slot membership as current or historical prose.
- Update docs/adr/system/ADR-S-OCM-001-ocomp-kernel-and-typed-program-boundary.md and docs/adr/blockchain/ADR-B-WIR-001-protocol-identifiers-and-consensus-wire-contract.md for the same dynamic wire/membership model.
- Regenerated protocol registry/schema/preimage documentation is part of the same GREEN slices.

## Tests

- registration PoP rejects wrong chain, genesis, identity, key, epoch, purpose, high-S and malformed SEC1; exact canonical replay succeeds.
- dynamic accountability covers N=1 and representative N values through the current codec bound without literals in production OCOMP code.
- quorum vectors use the shared threshold supplied by the caller and cannot infer a different threshold.
- bitmap golden vectors cover indices 0, 7, 8, last participant and non-zero padding bits.
- all three snapshot bindings affect vote digest, sign-once record equality, quorum evidence and exact-retry/equivocation behavior.
- prefix decoder rejects truncated offsets, lengths, padding and oversized payloads without panic.

## Out of scope

No ValidatorSet storage, Metadosis state, node runtime, genesis or E2E changes in this issue.

title: Dynamic OCOMP membership follows ACTIVE ValidatorSet
description:
## Problem

OCOMP voting membership must always equal the ordered ACTIVE consensus ValidatorSet for each new attempt. Earlier fixed-committee, fixed-window and ordinary-user-gas assumptions are invalid.

## Normative specification

The authoritative target is /home/outbe-plan/dynamic-validator.md after its final lifecycle update. The epic includes dynamic membership, removal of OCOMP-specific live-job/member caps, the exact 1800-block compute-vote window, deadline jail, the validator-authenticated OCOMP system-vote lane, the required FullNode Lysis follower, and final reachable E2E.

## Completion rule

All children must close in dependency order. Every behavior is implemented as a vertical RED→GREEN slice with exact Beads evidence. Current ADRs are rewritten in place and contain no fixed 4/q=3/four-slot/static committee architecture. Any new design expansion stops for user decision.
design: Fresh-genesis redesign. Keep consensus CommitteeEntry and committee_set_hash_v2 byte-identical. Store OCOMP registration and historical OCOMP snapshot extension in separate ValidatorSet slots at ordinals 50 or later. Metadosis slot formerly holding the static result committee remains a zero-valued reserved field of the same type and width so METADOSIS_STORAGE_LAYOUT_V1_HASH stays unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: ACTIVE ValidatorSet equals new-job OCOMP membership; historical jobs retain their pinned snapshots; no static committee, OCOMP-specific 256 assumption or MAX_LIVE_JOBS=2 remains; the compute-vote window is exactly 1800 blocks; deadline accountability records every missing pinned member and transitions only a member that is still currently ACTIVE to JAILED, with every non-ACTIVE status left unchanged and non-fatal; OCOMP votes use the canonical 30,000-gas system carrier without consuming user gas; FullNodes independently execute and verify Lysis fail-closed; focused tests, reachable E2E, documentation audit and all quality gates pass.
notes:
P1-P6 are completed foundations. P8 removes invalid limits, P10 installs the narrow OCOMP system-vote lane, P9 adds the 1800-block accountability/jail lifecycle, the reparented FullNode follower completes independent verification, and P7 is the final acceptance/gate task. Generalizing the system-transaction framework beyond OCOMP is explicitly deferred.
FEATURE ACCEPTANCE COMPLETE 2026-08-11: all children closed. Current release evidence proves ACTIVE ValidatorSet-derived OCOMP membership, historical snapshots, 4->5 live DKG/reshare, 5/q4 voting, 1800-block accountability with ACTIVE-only jail, canonical system carrier behavior, keyless FullNode computation/verification and restart. Required quality/docs gates pass.

title: Fix purpose-bound DcapRequired onboarding key delivery
description:
## Problem
Real production Validator and FullNode DcapRequired onboarding cannot complete. TeeRegistry emits the mandatory deterministic offer-key artifact after accepted RegisterEnclave, but the production enclave command matrix denies both SealOfferKeyForRegistry and IngestSealedOfferKeyForRegistry for every profile/readiness state, so execution becomes Fatal. This P0 is a prerequisite for the three focused lifecycle gaps, not a new lifecycle feature.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Start a production NodeHost-authorized Gramine enclave under a DcapRequired chain.
2. Submit valid canonical RegisterEnclave evidence with valid node and enclave signatures for a keyless Validator or FullNode.
3. Observe TeeRegistry call emit_offer_key_sealed_for_registry_v1.
4. Observe command_allowed reject FinalizedAuthorizationRequired and Registry map the failed mandatory seal to PrecompileError::Fatal.
5. Note that unit tests using emit_offer_key_sealed_for_registry_v1_after_sealer_for_test do not exercise this production matrix.

## Required Outcome
Implement the purpose-bound verify-and-seal and exact keyless ingest contract in P0 of outbe-plan/dcap-three-lifecycle-gaps-target-ru.md. Keep raw host-selected source sealing denied, preserve consensus byte determinism and context-separated AEAD derivation, accept only exact write-once target artifacts, and retain the documented exact-recipient reorg semantics without FinalityFollower or remote networking.
design: Follow P0 in outbe-plan/dcap-three-lifecycle-gaps-target-ru.md. Implement one purpose-bound DCAP verify-and-seal request whose commitment includes canonical evidence, active policy, consensus timestamp and node/enclave signatures. Its optional artifact is deterministic across OST3 holders. Derive key and nonce from context_hash and static-static shared secret using distinct ONBOARDING_KEY_INFO_V1 and ONBOARDING_NONCE_INFO_V1 constants; both must differ from each other, DKG_SHARE_INFO and REGISTRY_NONCE_INFO. Exact replay is byte-identical; different contexts for one recipient never reuse key/nonce. Target recomputes context, key and expected nonce from its recipient secret and exact offer public key; a serialized nonce is checked but never trusted or used as authority. Registry emits only the purpose-bound result; raw host-selected source sealing remains denied. No FinalityFollower or remote networking; the documented exact-recipient reorg semantic is accepted.
acceptance_criteria: Real DcapRequired Validator and FullNode join succeeds through the production command matrix; invalid evidence/signatures/recipient create no artifact; two OST3 source nodes return byte-identical exact artifacts; exact replay is identical and different context hashes for one recipient prove AEAD key/nonce separation; onboarding HKDF tags are pinned and distinct from every DKG/registry-seal domain; ingest recomputes expected nonce and rejects a modified wire nonce before AEAD open; raw source sealing remains denied; cross-chain/context/replay artifacts fail; existing key cannot be overwritten; crash/reopen and accepted reorg behavior are covered without claiming canonical admission.
notes:
FOCUS RESET 2026-08-03: replaces the withdrawn DeliveryAuthorized/FinalityFollower design with a narrow SecretNetwork-like one-time issuance prerequisite and explicit reorg semantics.
EXTERNAL CRYPTO REVIEW 2026-08-03: accepted two mandatory refinements. Onboarding HKDF key/nonce tags are independent of DKG_SHARE_INFO and existing REGISTRY_NONCE_INFO. Target ingest derives the expected nonce from authenticated public context and its own secret; the wire nonce is non-authoritative and any mismatch fails before decrypt.
IMPLEMENTATION INVENTORY — 2026-08-03

Цель этого блока — не менять acceptance, а исключить повторное исследование и многократные переделки одних файлов.

ARCHITECTURAL SHAPE

- Общие host-only RPC/relay/Registry adapters размещаются под feature operator в outbe-tee. Production enclave этот feature не включает; новая общая lifecycle security architecture и единый supervisor не создаются.
- Canonical TeeRegistry V1 ABI выносится в outbe-primitives и переиспользуется precompile и host operator code. Это убирает две расходящиеся sol! схемы.
- Большой bin/outbe-cli/src/commands/tee.rs после P0 остаётся тонким CLI adapter. Логика onboarding/finality/reopen живёт в reusable host-only модуле, чтобы renewal и upgrade не наращивали этот файл ещё раз.

PLANNED PRODUCTION SURFACE

Protocol and enclave:
- crates/system/tee/Cargo.toml
- crates/system/tee/src/lib.rs
- crates/system/tee/src/dcap_protocol.rs
- crates/system/tee/src/protocol.rs
- crates/system/tee/src/codec.rs
- crates/system/tee/src/client.rs
- crates/system/tee/src/client_global.rs
- crates/system/tee/src/host_ops/mod.rs
- crates/system/tee/src/host_ops/rpc.rs
- crates/system/tee/src/host_ops/registry.rs
- crates/system/tee/src/host_ops/onboarding.rs
- bin/outbe-tee-enclave/src/crypto.rs
- bin/outbe-tee-enclave/src/initialization.rs
- bin/outbe-tee-enclave/src/dcap_verifier.rs
- bin/outbe-tee-enclave/src/transport.rs

Canonical ABI and Registry:
- crates/blockchain/primitives/src/lib.rs
- crates/blockchain/primitives/src/tee_registry_abi_v1.rs new
- crates/system/teeregistry/src/v1.rs
- crates/system/teeregistry/src/v1_precompile.rs

CLI integration:
- bin/outbe-cli/Cargo.toml
- bin/outbe-cli/src/abi.rs
- bin/outbe-cli/src/rpc.rs
- bin/outbe-cli/src/tx.rs only if the shared relay extraction lands in P0
- bin/outbe-cli/src/commands/tee.rs
- Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock for feature/dependency wiring

ONE-PASS EDIT ORDER

P0-A: define canonical ABI, request commitment, typed outcome/artifact and wire codec first.
P0-B: implement context-bound key/nonce derivation, exact ingest and fatal durable persistence result inside production command matrix.
P0-C: change TeeRegistry verifier result plumbing and delete the raw post-verification seal call from production register flow.
P0-D: move onboarding orchestration to host_ops and make CLI wait for exact finalized binding, ingest, restart/reopen and exact offer-public check.
P0-E: run focused negative matrix and real DcapRequired Validator/FullNode E2E.

TEST MATRIX

- crypto unit: exact replay byte identity; same recipient plus different context changes key and nonce; pinned domain tags differ from every DKG/registry tag; wire nonce mutation rejects before AEAD open.
- artifact unit: wrong chain, genesis, intent, node, enclave, recipient, offer public, key epoch and malformed/capped framing reject.
- enclave production session: invalid quote/policy/node signature/enclave signature produces no artifact; raw Seal remains denied; keyless ingest is write-once; persistence failure is not reported as success; corrupt/partial sealed_root fails closed.
- protocol/client: Begin/Chunk/Finish commitment includes operation, evidence, policy, timestamp and both signatures; response signature and exact request echo are checked.
- Registry public path: production precompile succeeds without test sealer; verifier artifact is consumed from the same capability; rejected verification and second raw seal cannot mutate or emit.
- CLI/orchestration: receipt without finality is insufficient; finalized wrong binding is insufficient; exact binding plus ingest plus durable reopen succeeds; accepted reorg leaves key possession but never reports canonical join.
- hardware: one real SGX Validator and one FullNode DcapRequired onboarding through the same production matrix.

FOCUSED COMMANDS

cargo test -p outbe-primitives --features tee-attestation-v1
cargo test -p outbe-tee
cargo test -p outbe-tee-enclave --lib
cargo test -p outbe-teeregistry --features tee-attestation-v1
cargo test -p outbe-cli

The test-only sealer seam may remain for isolated Registry tests, but it is not accepted as the sole proof of production onboarding.
INVENTORY CORRECTION — 2026-08-03

Supersedes references above to an operator feature and host_ops directory inside outbe-tee.

The shared host plane is a new workspace crate:
- crates/blockchain/operator/Cargo.toml
- crates/blockchain/operator/src/lib.rs
- crates/blockchain/operator/src/rpc.rs
- crates/blockchain/operator/src/tx.rs
- crates/blockchain/operator/src/tee/mod.rs
- crates/blockchain/operator/src/tee/registry.rs
- crates/blockchain/operator/src/tee/onboarding.rs

Package name: outbe-operator. It depends on outbe-tee and outbe-primitives; outbe-tee and the enclave never depend on it. This prevents host HTTP/relay/journal dependencies from entering the enclave build graph through feature unification. bin/outbe-cli keeps compatibility reexports for its existing rpc.rs/tx.rs API, so unrelated command files are not mechanically rewritten.

title: Test planned Simplex replacement journal safety with real storage
description: Test-only diagnostic slice. Canonical types/compatibility: none changed. Ownership: crates/blockchain/consensus test seam only; stack/vendor remain untouched. Expected paths: crates/blockchain/consensus/src/shutdown_tests.rs only unless a separate test module is mechanically required. One semantic test pass. title: Drain Simplex journal before consensus stack exits on global stop
description: The exact release SGX dynamic-membership run passed all 14 functional steps but validator-4 panicked during intentional SIGTERM because the consensus stack's biased P2P/marshal exit branch returned before the current Simplex engine completed its voter journal sync. This recurs beyond the engine-only shutdown fix in outbe-chain-2c2.11. Fix only the observed global-stop owner ordering; do not change DKG, consensus, role eligibility, journal format, or error classification.
design: FIXED POINT: dce3a1ae8a8f412ed05b6449fe3db753c0e3b261. SCOPE: crates/blockchain/engine/src/stack.rs global-stop ownership plus production-routed component test support in the existing engine/consensus test seams; main.rs only if the RED proves its post-stop abort races after stack ownership is corrected. NON-GOALS: no role-replacement/epoch-transition abort redesign, no local Simplex shutdown API, no Commonware upgrade, no DKG/committee/gate/timing change, no wire/state/journal-format/crypto change, no log whitelist, no swallowing real Journal failures. INVARIANTS: global stop has priority over sibling component-exit notifications; the stack awaits the current Simplex engine and therefore its voter sync before returning; a true Journal sync failure remains panic/fatal; unexpected P2P/marshal exit while not globally stopping retains existing fatal/exit behavior; duplicate global stop coalesces into the same drain; restart opens/replays the same durable journal; outer shutdown deadline/hard-abort policy is unchanged. TRANSITION MATRIX: Running + GlobalStop + engine/voter Running + sibling exit ready => await current engine drain, no restart, then stack exits cleanly; Running + GlobalStop + engine already complete => observe completion then exit; Draining + duplicate GlobalStop => same drain/no duplicate effects; Draining + sync success => clean stack completion/restart replayable; Draining + sync error => existing fatal; Running + unexpected network/marshal exit without GlobalStop => existing fatal/stack-exit path; deadline expiry => existing outer hard-abort/error policy; restart only after prior owner completes. CANONICAL COMPATIBILITY: no canonical types, wire bytes, state, storage layout, journal format, ABI, or consensus algorithm change. OWNERS: stack.rs owns parent lifecycle ordering; vendored Simplex engine remains owner of voter drain from .11. HOT FILE: stack.rs one newly re-frozen integration-correction pass; any additional semantic pass or main.rs requirement triggers re-audit before edit. TEST/EVIDENCE: faithful component RED with real pinned Simplex/Tokio/filesystem Journal and sibling exit ordering; focused outbe-engine/outbe-consensus gates, clippy; exact release SGX/no-attest dynamic-membership rerun with 14/14 and clean audit. PR SLICE: one independently green lifecycle correction; role-replacement durability is a separate follow-up.
acceptance_criteria: A faithful production-routed component RED proves that when global stop and a sibling network exit become ready together, the owning stack remains alive until the real Simplex voter journal flush completes. The fix makes that test green, preserves fatal handling of true sync failures and unexpected live network exits, and the exact release SGX dynamic-membership scenario passes with clean log audit.

title: Keep dynamic OCOMP clock transition supplied by the real price feeder
description: The dynamic OCOMP membership fixture has two causal harness defects. First, Job B is scheduled at genesis+700s while validator-5 activation is height-based at h300; SGX/admission latency allowed Job B to pin at h299/300 before the five-member ACTIVE state, making the required joiner vote impossible. Second, the custom two-hop clock restart leaves node-facing SnapshotExporter/Worker processes running while their embedded Supervisors disappear, unlike the canonical restart sequence. Scope is harness-only: testing/e2e-harness/src/world/ocomp.rs, testing/e2e-harness/src/features/ocomp.rs, and the existing validator_lifecycle.feature feeder step. Product OCOMP membership, vote eligibility, ValidatorSet, wire/state, timing, Oracle TTL, and DKG are explicit non-goals.
design: ARCHITECTURE FREEZE. Invariants: (I1) Job B cannot become due before the certified five-member activation is canonical; (I2) its finalized request height must be strictly after the certified activation height and its intent must pin five members/quorum four; (I3) every node clock restart quiesces all currently attached SnapshotExporters and Workers before node shutdown; (I4) restart restores exactly the captured live role inventory, never resurrecting intentionally stopped workers 2/3; (I5) all five nodes reach one fresh common finalized barrier before exporters/workers resume; (I6) feeder stop/resume/publication remains production-shaped; (I7) historical Job A remains pinned four/quorum three; (I8) no product behavior changes. Transition matrix: Scheduled-B + activation pending + natural blocks => remains Scheduled/no effects; Scheduled-B + certified ACTIVE(5) + controlled daily barrier => Request pinned 5/q4; RunningRoleInventory + clock-stop => Suspended(exact exporters/workers), no typed fault record; Suspended + nodes restarted/common finality => Resume exact inventory; missing role/start failure => harness failure/no partial acceptance; workers 2/3 absent before suspend => absent after resume; replay/restart repeats the same durable schedule and captured inventory; deadline behavior is bounded harness timeout only. Canonical types/compatibility: no wire/state/API change; add only harness-owned resume-plan type if needed. Ownership: dynamic schedule and resume-plan in world/ocomp.rs; causal guards/orchestration in features/ocomp.rs. Hot files: each gets one implementation pass and at most one integration correction. Ordered slices: RED schedule invariant; GREEN controlled post-activation schedule/guard; RED exact live-role roundtrip; GREEN suspend/restart/resume; focused harness gates; exact release SGX/no-attest scenario and clean audit.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic tests prove Job B due time is the next controlled UTC boundary after activation rather than genesis+700, and prove a five-domain live-role snapshot roundtrip restores exporters 0..4 plus workers 0/1/4 while workers 2/3 remain absent. The exact release SGX/no-attest dynamic-membership scenario proves Job B request height > certified activation height, 5/q4 snapshot, joiner vote, validator-2 quorum completion, both deadlines, continued finality, and clean log audit. No production files change.

title: ACTIVE joiner remains verifier after canonical signer eligibility transition
description:
ID: E2E-DKG-JOINER-SHARE-001
Status: confirmed-product-defect
Observed: A pending joiner completes the five-player reshare and persists threshold material, but at the exact epoch activation the node starts Simplex in VERIFIER mode. ValidatorSet promotes it ACTIVE one block later, and every subsequent finalized view records a voter miss against the joiner.
Expected: A joiner included in the canonical reshare target and holding the completed epoch share must start the activated consensus epoch as a signer before ACTIVE accountability begins.
Production reachability: Ordinary validator admission, canonical 4-to-5 DKG reshare, joiner process/enclave restart, exact activation at height 120, ACTIVE promotion at height 121.
Reproduction command: release outbe-e2e, tee=sgx-no-attest, sudo=true, validators=4, scenario 'In-flight DKG survives a joining node and enclave restart'.
SHA/environment: main fixed point dce3a1ae8a8f412ed05b6449fe3db753c0e3b261; branch contains harness-only corrections; real gramine-sgx with remote attestation disabled, chain_id 54322345.
Evidence: /tmp/e2e-dkg-membership-triage/run-1787570798-501603/scenario-1/validator-4/node.log. Lines 1318-1323 reconstruct and persist the five-player DKG output; lines 2143-2148 activate epoch 1 but log 'no threshold share ... VERIFIER mode'; line 2161 commits active_count=5; lines 2213-2287 record joiner voter misses 1..5 at blocks 124..128. The initial aggregate independently observed the same accumulating misses.
Test setup validity: The scenario uses the public admission/stake/confirm-ready path, canonical DKG boundary, durable datadir and SGX enclave restart; committee continues finalizing and all DKG hashes agree.
Affected invariant/postcondition: ACTIVE validator accountability must not start before the same validator can sign with its canonical epoch share.
Competing causes excluded: DKG failure excluded by canonical threshold completion and persisted output; missing membership excluded by five-player target and active_count=5; chain stall excluded by continued finality; fixture timing excluded by repeated exact activation behavior.
Root cause: The activation path selects verifier mode despite the completed local share for the incoming epoch, before/while on-chain ACTIVE promotion becomes visible.
Counterfactual proof: Loading the persisted epoch-1 share at activation would select signer/player mode; the observed verifier-only node is the direct reason it cannot vote and accumulates misses.
Proposed minimal fix: Product lifecycle correction in the engine/DKG activation ownership seam; no product edit is authorized in this E2E goal.
Regression: Preserve this exact 4-to-5 admission plus joiner restart scenario and assert signer-mode activation and unchanged voter-miss count across subsequent finalized views.
Verdict scope: Confirmed for a newly admitted validator whose completed reshare activates after the joiner was restarted during the in-flight DKG.
design:
SCOPE
Fix the consensus epoch lifecycle after a canonical Radicle voting-gate transition. A running epoch created as Verifier must restart as Signer when and only when the current canonical snapshot becomes SignerAllowed and a valid local share is already loaded. A running Signer must restart as Verifier immediately when the canonical gate becomes Verifier.

NON-GOALS
No DKG target/replay/output change; no ValidatorSet activation timing change; no Radicle status semantics change; no Simplex/Commonware protocol fork; no wire, storage, journal, ABI, committee, accountability, or epoch-number change; no signing while SelfAbsent/Verifier; no fabricated share or fallback signer.

INVARIANTS
1. Verifier never signs.
2. Signer requires both canonical SignerAllowed and a locally validated share.
3. A gate change is applied exactly once to the running epoch role; duplicate snapshots are idempotent.
4. Fatal gate remains node-fatal and is never translated into a role restart.
5. SignerAllowed without a share remains Verifier.
6. Role replacement keeps the same epoch, participants, floor/journal partition, validation providers, and VRF material version.
7. The old engine is aborted and observed stopped before same-epoch channels are reacquired; inability to reacquire is fatal, never a second concurrent engine.
8. Process restart snapshots the current gate and directly starts the correct role.
9. Role replacement does not alter DKG activation, canonical history, or accountability data.

TRANSITION MATRIX
- Verifier/no-share + Verifier: no effect; replay/restart remains Verifier; no deadline.
- Verifier/no-share + SignerAllowed: no effect because capability is absent; replay/restart remains Verifier; no deadline.
- Verifier/share + Verifier: no effect; restart remains Verifier.
- Verifier/share + SignerAllowed: stop current engine, reacquire same-epoch vote/cert/res routes, rebuild signer scheme from the already validated share, recover the same journal, resume; duplicate SignerAllowed after restart is no-op.
- Signer/share + SignerAllowed: no effect; duplicate/replay idempotent.
- Signer/share + Verifier: stop current engine before any later signing, reacquire same-epoch routes, rebuild verifier scheme, recover same journal, resume; duplicate Verifier after restart is no-op.
- Any role + Fatal(error): return the exact fatal error; no restart.
- Any role + status channel closed: keep the current role and wait forever as today; no inferred authorization.
- Any role + engine/network exit: preserve current shutdown behavior.
- Any role + epoch/DKG activation: existing epoch transition wins through the biased event loop; next epoch snapshots the gate normally.
- Transitioning + duplicate gate update: coalesced by the watch snapshot; the rebuilt iteration evaluates latest canonical state.
- Transitioning + channel reacquisition timeout/error: node-fatal; never run two engines and never silently remain in the stale role.
- Process restart in any stable state: current canonical snapshot plus persisted validated share selects role directly.
Deadlines: no protocol deadline is added. Same-epoch route reacquisition uses one bounded local lifecycle timeout; expiry is fatal and replay after process restart is safe.

CANONICAL TYPES / COMPATIBILITY
No canonical type, encoded byte, state layout, event, signature namespace, committee definition, epoch, journal partition, or RPC/ABI changes. Fresh and existing state are compatible.

OWNERSHIP / PATH MAP
- crates/blockchain/engine/src/stack.rs owns gate-to-running-role coordination and engine replacement.
- crates/blockchain/consensus/src/epoch_subchannels.rs owns safe same-epoch route reacquisition after old receiver teardown, only if the RED/implementation proves it necessary.
- crates/blockchain/engine/src/stack_tests.rs owns the production-routed role-transition RED and lifecycle regressions.
- crates/blockchain/consensus tests own a route-reacquisition regression only if epoch_subchannels.rs changes.
Hot-file budget for this independent PR slice: stack.rs one implementation pass plus at most one integration correction; epoch_subchannels.rs one implementation pass plus at most one correction.

ORDERED PR SLICES
PR19.1 test-only faithful RED for Verifier/share + SignerAllowed and no early signing.
PR19.2 minimal same-epoch role replacement and, if required, channel reacquisition support; focused GREEN plus engine/consensus suites.
PR19.3 release SGX/no-attest 4-to-5 join/restart proof: identical DKG output, active_count=5, joiner signs, voter misses do not increase, logs clean.

EVIDENCE
Record the exact RED command/output before production edits, focused GREEN, fmt/clippy, affected crate suites, and the original release SGX scenario.
acceptance_criteria: A production fix loads the incoming validator's canonical completed DKG share before signer accountability, a focused regression is red before/green after, and the release SGX admission scenario passes with no new voter misses.

Closure clarification and evidence (2026-08-24): the confirmed root was stale same-epoch role, not a missing DKG share. Product now transitions Verifier/share -> SignerAllowed by safely replacing the running Simplex role after canonical gate publication. Release SGX proof passed at /tmp/r19c/evidence/run-1787583118-989128/scenario-001.json with identical five-player DKG output, active_count=5, successful same-epoch signer restart, stable post-eligibility voter-miss counter, and clean 15-log audit.

Boundary accounting clarification: the activation carrier block 121 is finalized before executing the state change that publishes ACTIVE/SignerAllowed. Its K=3 absentee accounting therefore closes at block 124 and may add exactly the historical pre-eligibility miss. This does not contradict 'no new misses after eligibility'; the E2E now closes that window before establishing its baseline. No ValidatorSet or accountability timing was changed.

title: DKG retry uses stale queued height and can freeze a divergent canonical output
description: A timed-out DKG attempt can retain canonical dealer logs while the ordered execution-height channel accumulates older notifications. The retry is then triggered by the oldest queued height and resets DkgManager before replaying only through that stale scheduling height, even though the execution provider has already been verified at a newer consensus-finalized tip. The lost canonical prefix lets later retry dealer logs form a different first-threshold subset on different validators. Runtime evidence on main dce3a1ae: v0-v2 started at height 40, timed out after canonical logs at 97/98, retried from queued height 41 while canonical tip was 104, and froze output 8f190f...; restarted v3 retained the prefix and froze fdc8e8.... Three independent read-only audits converged on this exact cause after rejecting the naive manager-reset hypothesis.
design:
ARCHITECTURE FREEZE (2026-08-24)

Scope: repair only the DKG ceremony recovery/retry seam that rebuilds node-local canonical DKG state from already-finalized block headers. The same recovery primitive may be used by live reshare, frozen-target retry, and verifier-follower startup so they cannot drift. Non-goals: no change to DKG cryptography, dealer/player generation, N3f1 thresholds, first-threshold freeze semantics, wire/header/boundary artifacts, canonical storage layouts, ValidatorSet/Radicle role transitions, activation/grace/expiry timing, SGX behavior, or generic consensus finalization.

Canonical compatibility: no wire, ABI, block-header, state, persisted retry snapshot, or boundary artifact type changes. Existing finalized DealerLog bytes and ordering remain authoritative. Fresh-genesis and rolling compatibility are unchanged because this is node-local reconstruction orchestration only.

Invariants:
I1. For one (epoch, round, previous output, ordered target set), every node folding the same canonical finalized DealerLog history through a given finalized watermark freezes the same output.
I2. A queued scheduling height may trigger recovery but must never bound canonical replay. Replay watermark is the latest consensus-finalized tip whose exact hash is present in the execution provider.
I3. Rehydration is atomic relative to live finalized DealerLog delivery: artifacts at or below the watermark are folded exactly in canonical height order; artifacts above it cannot overtake the prefix and are released afterward in canonical order.
I4. Missing header/hash mismatch/decode failure does not silently advance replay or publish a partially rebuilt ceremony. It yields ProviderNotReady/RetryPending, preserves honest no-boundary/no-output state, starts no replacement actor, and retries without fabricating or discarding canonical evidence.
I5. Existing per-dealer first-finalized/idempotent duplicate semantics and freeze-on-first-reconstructable-prefix remain unchanged after the complete prefix is restored.
I6. The local DKG actor receives the same canonical replay prefix used by DkgManager, exactly once per recovery generation; gossip candidates never become canonical input.
I7. Restart and repeated timeout/retry are idempotent: a completed canonical output is not recomputed; an incomplete ceremony resumes from the same prefix and cannot mix attempts.
I8. Existing planned activation, grace and expiry deadlines remain authoritative. Recovery may retry while inside the existing window; at the existing deadline it fails exactly as before and never extends the window.

Transition matrix:
- Idle/no target + scheduling height: existing freeze/start behavior; establish authoritative provider-backed consensus watermark before replay; actor role may be DealerAndPlayer, PlayerOnly, DealerOnly, or absent verifier-follower.
- Collecting + canonical DealerLog: fold once, notify active actor, remain Collecting or freeze Reconstructed at the first complete canonical prefix.
- Collecting + DKG success: existing durable boundary/preannounce/activation flow; no recovery change.
- Collecting + timeout/error before expiry: enter RetryPending; keep scheduling backlog separate from replay authority; do not publish a replacement ceremony yet.
- RetryPending + provider matches consensus tip: enter Rehydrating, fence/buffer live finalized artifacts, collect every canonical header from freeze through tip, then atomically publish the rebuilt ceremony and actor feed; transition to Collecting or Reconstructed.
- RetryPending + provider missing tip/header, hash mismatch, or decode error: no partial install and no actor start; remain RetryPending and retry on provider readiness.
- Rehydrating + live artifact height <= watermark: canonical replay owns it; duplicate delivery is idempotent.
- Rehydrating + live artifact height > watermark: buffer, then release only after the replay prefix in height order.
- Rehydrating + reconstruction reaches threshold: freeze only after the ordered prefix up to that artifact is installed; later logs never recompute.
- Repeated same-ceremony retry/restart: rebuild from canonical history and obtain byte-identical output; stale prior actor/result is generation-fenced and ignored.
- Any state + boundary already committed/activated: existing boundary/epoch path wins; recovery cannot reopen it.
- Any pre-activation state + existing grace deadline reached: preserve current fatal expiry behavior; no synthetic boundary/output.
- Process restart: the live/follower recovery path uses the same authoritative watermark and atomic prefix rule before accepting live artifacts.

Ownership/path map:
- crates/blockchain/engine/src/stack.rs owns ordered scheduling notifications, authoritative consensus-tip/provider readiness, header scan, retry generation and actor start. Hot file: one implementation pass plus at most one integration correction.
- crates/blockchain/consensus/src/dkg_manager.rs owns atomic ceremony replacement/rehydration and ordering of concurrently arriving finalized artifacts. Hot file: one implementation pass plus at most one integration correction.
- crates/blockchain/consensus/src/dkg_manager/ceremony.rs remains unchanged and continues to own the pure fold/first-threshold semantics.
- Expected tests: crates/blockchain/engine/src/stack_tests.rs for stale queued-height vs authoritative-tip recovery and provider-not-ready rows; crates/blockchain/consensus/src/dkg_manager/tests/mod.rs only if the atomic buffering contract needs direct coverage. Existing DKG manager/actor/restart tests remain green.
- Release evidence: exact four-to-five delayed/restarted DKG SGX/no-attest scenario, one output hash on all nodes, one activation, active_count=5, continued finality, clean log audit.

Ordered PR slice: one independently green PR for this recovery seam. Commit checkpoints inside it are (1) faithful deterministic RED through the production recovery helper, observed failing on fixed point dce3a1ae; (2) minimal recovery implementation; (3) focused DKG/engine gates and exact release SGX evidence. The RED is not delivered as a standalone broken PR. Any need to edit another production path, change canonical types/timing, or make a third semantic pass triggers stop/replan and a new three-agent audit.
acceptance_criteria: A faithful deterministic regression drives the production retry recovery with queued scheduling height 41 while the verified canonical provider tip is 104 and canonical DealerLogs exist above 41. The test fails on fixed point dce3a1ae by producing a missing/different output versus uninterrupted canonical replay. After the fix, retry/restart/live recovery folds the complete canonical prefix atomically, all nodes produce the same output, provider gaps fail without partial state, focused tests pass, and the exact release sudo SGX/no-attest four-to-five restart scenario activates once with active_count=5, continued finality, and clean logs.
close_reason: Faithful RED and frozen atomic recovery are green; superseding exact release SGX 4-to-5 evidence proves one converged output, active_count=5, continued finality, and clean logs.
