comments.author: Aleksandr
comments.text: ARCHITECTURE FREEZE / GREEN 2026-08-24. Fixed point dce3a1ae8a8f412ed05b6449fe3db753c0e3b261. Scope: patch exactly pinned Reth v2.2.0 transaction-pool source identity 88505c7, only queued-lifetime removal observability; retain the confirmed component RED and tighten E2E later. Non-goals: no eviction timing/filter/membership/config/origin change, no pending two-snapshot change, no txpool consensus/state/wire change, no generic listener or log whitelist. Invariants: every transaction actually removed by queued-lifetime maintenance emits exactly one WARN target outbe::txpool with tx_hash, sender, nonce, reason=queued_lifetime; candidates that are stale but concurrently absent emit nothing; blob deletion and removal ordering stay unchanged; External is evicted, Local is exempt unless no_local_exemptions=true exactly as today. Transition matrix: Queued age<=TTL + tick -> retained/no event; Queued age>TTL External + tick -> remove, delete blob if applicable, exact structured event; Queued age>TTL Local + exemptions enabled -> retained/no event; same Local + no_exemptions -> remove/event; candidate concurrently mined/removed before remove result -> no structured eviction claim; Pending/BaseFee/Blob subpool + queued tick -> unchanged; duplicate tick after removal -> no event; restart resets existing wall-clock residence timestamp behavior unchanged; deadline remains strict existing wall-clock age > max_tx_lifetime and existing interval cadence. Errors: pool removal remains infallible/current behavior; observability cannot affect removal. Replay: no durable replay/event duplication. Canonical types/compatibility: none. Owner: vendored reth-transaction-pool maintain queued-lifetime branch. Expected paths: vendor/reth-transaction-pool/** mechanical exact crate plus maintain.rs one semantic pass and provenance/licenses, Cargo.toml source-wide patch/exclude, Cargo.lock, crates/blockchain/txpool/src/maintain.rs + Cargo.toml test-only RED, later testing/e2e-harness txpool assertion only. Hot budget: vendored maintain.rs implementation + one correction. Tests: current faithful component RED covers External/remove/exact fields; add actual-removal/no-event and Local exemption table at same seam; existing pending staleness tests remain green; package test/clippy; public-RPC E2E binds hash/reason on nodes that held it. PR slice independently green and changes only logging.

Timing/filter/membership/blob deletion and pending-staleness semantics are unchanged. Expected and touched production path match; one semantic pass, no consensus/state/wire change. title: Resolve lease-expiry protected-output contract
description: Expiry correctly makes Registry readiness false and closes remote sessions, but local secret-bearing enclave commands remain authorized whenever the permanent offer key is resident. Decision-map #15 expects protocol outputs to stop at expiry, while the implementation plan explicitly defers protected-execution and consensus membership gating. Decide and specify the cross-module contract before implementation.
design: Do not remove a validator from the current BLS/DKG committee by a per-block timestamp filter. Current committee indices, quorum and threshold material are epoch-scoped. If continuous lease authority is required, define finalized proof delivery to secret commands and any membership effect only through the next finalized reshare/status transition. If testnet adopts Secret-Network-like one-time consensus admission, correct the lease claims instead of adding unsafe consensus wiring.
acceptance_criteria: One explicit decision states whether expiry governs only new registration/remote sessions or also protected outputs and future consensus eligibility; committee transition timing and finalized timestamp authority are defined; current-epoch quorum/DKG invariants are preserved; testnet blocking status and reachable tests are specified; no implementation starts until this decision is accepted.
notes: DECISION RESOLVED — 2026-08-03. Validator binding and exact EpochRoleGrant are immutable through the current epoch; mid-epoch lease expiry or policy cutoff closes generic sessions but exact epoch-scoped consensus, execution and explicitly granted DKG reconnect remain valid until the boundary. At the next freeze an expired binding becomes AttestationSuspended. If eligible threshold or DKG completion is insufficient, the next epoch does not activate and the network halts fail-closed; the old grant is not extended. FullNode has no epoch grant: expiry closes protected execution and serving, leaves only headers, bodies backlog, finality control and renewal, then normal executor catches up after finalized renewal. Security time is finalized consensus timestamp and consensus or peers independently validate accepted outputs.
close_reason: Epoch-safe expiry and protected-output contract resolved in the three-agent validated lifecycle design.

title: Reconcile orphan PFS-011-01 marker with OCOMP evidence ledger
description:
Finding OCOMP-ID-001. Status: test-defect. Observed on code HEAD c63c55f560d045c59a138fe42f0b14739d0e9284 with the layout move still uncommitted: cargo test -p outbe-e2e-harness --test ocomp_evidence_verifier fails only task_progress_passes_all_discovered_ids_and_leaves_future_ids_missing because source contains unknown OCOMP test ID PFS-011-01. Expected: every OCOMP-TEST-ID marker is owned by outbe-plan/off-chain-poc-evidence-ledger.yaml. Production reachability: not applicable; this is evidence discovery and does not execute production consensus behavior. Evidence: testing/e2e-harness/features/ocomp_public_path.feature line 28 contains OCOMP-TEST-ID: PFS-011-01; the ledger has no PFS-011-01 entry; git blame attributes the marker to pre-existing commit 777624e625f7ce8ef32c1f2cc8a8c620d5b59912. The same pre-move discovery root at HEAD was crates/testing/e2e-harness, so the inconsistency predates the layout task. Test setup validity: the verifier is faithfully enforcing its exact-ID contract. Affected postcondition: OCOMP source discovery must contain no unknown explicit marker. Competing causes excluded: repository root resolution is correct because the verifier finds all moved sources and the error identifies the exact orphan marker; this is not sandbox-related. Root cause: a PFS-labelled scenario was given an OCOMP-owned marker without a corresponding OCOMP ledger record. No product-code change is proposed. Resolve evidence ownership explicitly: either add a ledger-owned OCOMP ID and bind the scenario, or reclassify/remove the OCOMP marker while retaining the PFS tag, then rerun the full verifier.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Run cargo test -p outbe-e2e-harness --test ocomp_evidence_verifier.
2. Observe task_progress_passes_all_discovered_ids_and_leaves_future_ids_missing fail with unknown OCOMP test ID PFS-011-01.
3. Confirm the feature contains that marker and the OCOMP evidence ledger has no matching ID.
design: Keep this separate from the repository layout commit. Do not guess whether PFS-011-01 belongs in the OCOMP ledger: its semantics and evidence lane must be chosen by the OCOMP plan owner.
acceptance_criteria: An explicit evidence-owner decision is recorded; the feature marker and OCOMP ledger agree; cargo test -p outbe-e2e-harness --test ocomp_evidence_verifier passes all 19 tests; no production behavior is changed merely to satisfy discovery.
notes:
## Steps to Reproduce

1. On commit c63c55f or current descendant, run cargo test -p outbe-e2e-harness --test ocomp_evidence_verifier.
2. Observe task_progress_passes_all_discovered_ids_and_leaves_future_ids_missing fail with unknown OCOMP test ID PFS-011-01.
3. Confirm testing/e2e-harness/features/ocomp_public_path.feature contains the marker and outbe-plan/off-chain-poc-evidence-ledger.yaml has no matching ID.
RESOLUTION — 2026-08-03
PFS-011-01 is owned by the PFS operational-key-delegation flow, not the OCOMP ledger. The feature keeps its stable PFS ID but uses the PFS-TEST-ID marker instead of OCOMP-TEST-ID. No production behavior changed. Verification: ocomp_evidence_verifier 19/19 PASS.
COMMIT RECORD — 2026-08-03
Resolved in SSH-signed commit ea77c74696f2e81100ef57fc6de91de9f2b61cce (verify-commit GREEN).
close_reason: Reclassified PFS-011-01 under its actual PFS evidence owner; OCOMP ledger verification passes all 19 tests with no product-code change.
